# Vox Director

Agent Skill for turning one topic into a paper-collage explainer or ad video.

- Read `SKILL.md` for the workflow.
- Read `SKILL.zh.md` for the Chinese workflow.
- Read `references/` before preparing prompts.
- Run the Python scripts in stages and finish with local FFmpeg assembly.

The repository-specific homepage and author metadata are intentionally omitted from this clean source bundle.
